breakdown.description: Specifying adiabatic vertical side walls but setting temperature boundary conditions as fixedValue 300 on sides. For adiabatic walls, use zeroGradient, not fixedValue. The walls should be adiabatic, not isothermal.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the contradiction. It correctly stated the high-level requirement "Set adiabatic conditions on vertical side walls." However, it then directly contradicted this by specifying the incorrect boundary condition in the detailed T field setup: "Set T field: uniform 300 initial, bottom 305, top 295, sides 300." Setting the sides to a fixed value of 300 is an isothermal condition, not an adiabatic one (which would require a zeroGradient condition).
